# Terraform

<!-- Generated by bazel run //tools/docs/languages:languages_bin -- --write from terraform/lang.json and terraform/defs.bzl. Do not edit. -->

This page helps you build, test and check Terraform code with rules_dx.

## Quick start

`MODULE.bazel` sits at the root of your repository and lists the Bazel modules, meaning external dependencies, that your project uses. Add `rules_dx` to it:

```python
bazel_dep(name = "rules_dx", version = "<release>")
```

Then let dx set up the rest, as in the [Quickstart](../../README.md#quickstart):

```sh
bazel run @rules_dx//:dx -- init --apply
```

For a Terraform project, `MODULE.bazel` then looks like this:

```python
module(name = "my_project")

bazel_dep(name = "rules_dx", version = "<release>")
```

A `BUILD.bazel` file declares targets: the libraries, binaries and tests that Bazel builds. This one is a small Terraform package from [`terraform/tests/consumer`](../../terraform/tests/consumer/BUILD.bazel):

```python
load("@rules_dx//terraform:defs.bzl", "terraform_library")

terraform_library(
    name = "terraform",
    srcs = ["main.tf"],
    visibility = ["//visibility:public"],
)
```

Build and test everything. `//...` means every target in the repository:

```sh
tools/dx test //...
```

## Rules

`load` brings rules into a `BUILD.bazel` file. Load the ones you use from `@rules_dx//terraform:defs.bzl`:

```python
load("@rules_dx//terraform:defs.bzl", "terraform_library", "terraform_provider")
```

### `terraform_library`

Owns the Terraform files of one module for dx format and lint.

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `deps` | `label_list` | no | Terraform modules this module calls. |
| `providers` | `label_list` | no | Providers of the module, from the terraform extension hub. |
| `srcs` | `label_list` | no | Terraform files of this module. |

### `terraform_provider`

One Terraform provider unpacked into the filesystem-mirror layout.

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `source` | `string` | yes | Provider source address HOST/NAMESPACE/TYPE. |
| `srcs` | `label_list` | yes | Files of the unpacked mirror tree. |
| `target` | `string` | yes | Terraform target platform. |
| `version` | `string` | yes | Provider version. |

## Tools and package files

dx runs these tools and reads these package files for Terraform:

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Tools | `terraform`, `tflint`, `trivy_config` |
| Ecosystems | none |
| Manifests | `*.tf` |
| Lockfiles | `terraform.lock.json`, `.terraform.lock.hcl` |

## Platforms

Terraform builds and tests on:

- Linux arm64
- Linux x86_64
- macOS arm64
- Windows arm64
- Windows x86_64
